SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.call_edges ce ON ce.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
WHERE f.file_id = 'tests/client/test_redirects.py'
  AND s.kind = 'function'
  AND s.name = 'redirects'
  AND ce.passes_as_callback = True
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
              FROM code.symbols client
              JOIN code.files client_f ON client.file_id = client_f.file_id
              WHERE client_f.file_id = 'tests/client/test_redirects.py'
                AND client.kind = 'class'
                AND client.name = 'AsyncClient'
                AND client.is_public = True)
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ce.call_id) > 0

request:

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query finds the `redirects` function symbol in tests/client/test_redirects.py, then checks that it has at least one call edge where it is passed as a callback (passes_as_callback = True), and that the same file also defines a public AsyncClient class.               FROM code.symbols client
              JOIN code.files client_f ON client.file_id = client_f.file_id
              WHERE client_f.file_id = 'tests/client/test_redirects.py'
                AND client.kind = 'class'
